evidence.detail: The class stores one URL and one destination File, opens a BufferedInputStream from the URL, streams 16 KiB chunks into FileOutputStream, flushes periodically and returns the downloaded File.
Before transfer it opens HttpURLConnection only to obtain content length, stores total bytes/current downloaded bytes/start time, and invokes the abstract progress hook after every successful chunk.
If the destination already exists, the downloader prints its absolute path, deletes it, then replaces it with the newly downloaded content.
The sole exact-v308 subclass rs/cache/a/a overrides only the abstract progress hook while inheriting the HTTP URL-to-File transfer implementation.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the abstract URL-to-File downloader used by the cache/client updater path.

evidence.detail: The subclass adds only a Client plus status-label String and overrides the progress hook to compute percentage, throughput and formatted kb/s or mb/s text before calling Client.b(percent,label,progressText).
Its direct callers supply exact live updater labels 'Downloading main game assets..', 'Downloading client..', 'Downloading game configs..' and 'Downloading sprites..'.
All network/file transfer mechanics remain in R372 HttpFileDownloader; this subclass contributes only client-facing progress presentation for those updater downloads.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the Client-aware progress-rendering downloader subclass.
